name: GitHub Dark Tritanopia
tagline: Green becomes blue, red stays red -- the blue-yellow axis rebuilt and nothing else touched.
notes: Differs from Colorblind by exactly one decision: red is left alone, because tritanopia does not confuse it.

contrast_exempt.muted: ANSI 8 is GitHub's own dimmed-text value and dimmed text is supposed to recede; lifting it would mean shipping a terminal palette GitHub does not have (measures 3.57:1)
